reviewCorrections: Corrected lottery rolldown valuation: E[1/W] is not 1/E[W]. The category-specific shared-fund EV now uses Fund*[1-(1-p)^N]/N.
Corrected must-drop finite-step valuation: wager probability now uses [F(q2)-F(q1)]/[1-F(q1)] rather than the infinitesimal hazard*dq approximation.
Confirmed the Euromillones cap and fifth-capped-draw redistribution rule from SELAE's own published Normas de Euromillones.
Rejected the generic inference EGT jackpot == must-hit-by; only exact jackpot families with primary rule evidence may enter the MHB gate.

Corrected multi-hand video poker EV: totalCoinsBet must scale as qualifyingCoinsBetPerHand*handsPerSpin (both the extra-jackpot-EV numerator AND the cost denominator scale with handsPerSpin, so betting more hands does not create a free EV multiplier). Fixed in PR #190.

Corrected progressive-signal detection: 'Royal'/'Escalera Real' text is NOT itself proof of a progressive jackpot (most non-progressive video poker also has a Royal Flush hand); and substring 'bote' was false-positively matching 'Botemania' itself. Both fixed in PR #190 via whole-word/whole-phrase matching (see botemania-video-poker-jackpot-probe-v1.json version 'v1.2-whole-word-signals').

PR #192: the global mustDropWithin scan (v1) counted a chunk as scanned even when its fetch had failed, silently understating coverage. This guard (chunksTargeted/chunksFetchedSuccessfully/chunkFetchFailureCount/fetchCoveragePct/scanComplete, with negativeResultInterpretableAsCompleteScan only true at full coverage) must never be removed. The fixed script has not produced a fresh run yet as of this pass - the evidence file on main is still the pre-fix run's output (366 chunks discovered, 361 scanned, 5 hits, no coverage fields).
